component.name: Kestic
component.summary: Simple and powerful backups with restic

description.p: Kestic makes backups with restic easy. Pick what and where. Kestic does the rest and shows you the restic command behind every run.

ul.li: Destinations: external drives, folders, SSH servers, REST servers, cloud storage and cloud services via rclone
Schedules that catch up after sleep or shutdown, with run conditions for AC power and the network
Exclude rules and retention, each with a preview
Browse, search and compare snapshots, and restore files to a new folder or, after a preview, to their original place

description.p: Kestic is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by KDE e.V. or the restic project.
